source.method: Daily ratio of the Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR closing price to the Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR closing price, on the dates both funds traded. Closes are split- and dividend-adjusted, so the ratio is a total-return relative. No rebasing: both funds listed on 1998-12-22. `highs` and `lows` are the dates on which the ratio set a new record over the history to that point.
source.constituents: S&P Consumer Discretionary Select Sector Index and S&P Consumer Staples Select Sector Index — the S&P 500 members classified into GICS sectors 25 and 30.
